reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Zad Vet Clinic in Sharjah. Their prices are very affordable without compromising the quality of care. Dr. Islam and Dr. Ahmed are both incredibly friendly, professional, and genuinely care about their patients. I highly recommend Zad Vet Clinic to anyone looking for compassionate, reliable, and affordable veterinary care for their pets. Thank you for taking such great care of my cats!

reviews.author: Muhammad Soban
reviews.text:
Today, we took our cat for grooming to Zad Veterinary Clinic, located behind the Sharjah Bird Market. Upon arrival, we were informed that the grooming charges would be AED 120, which we agreed to.
Unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing and distressing.
The staff was completely unprofessional
The groomer’s behavior towards our cat was very harsh and unacceptable
During grooming, the groomer cut our cat’s leg with scissors
The cat’s ears were held and twisted so forcefully that blood clotted on them
Without informing us about any of these injuries, our cat was immediately locked in a cage and handed over to us
Normally, at other veterinary clinics, the pet is first shown to the owner and any issues are clearly explained before placing the pet in a cage. However, none of this standard procedure was followed here.
In addition, the grooming and haircut were extremely poor and careless the fur was uneven, messy, and completely unprofessional.
We are sharing pictures of our cat along with this post, which clearly show the condition she was returned in.
We strongly advise all pet owners to be extremely careful when choosing a grooming or veterinary facility.
If animals are not treated with care and comfort, such places cause nothing but harm.
